description: GBA-2's FASMARM golden-gate proof: rebuilds jsmolka/gba-tests' arm/arm.gba unmodified from its pinned source and checks it against the binary jsmolka shipped at that commit. Proves tools/rom-toolchain's fasmarm stage reproduces this suite's toolchain byte-for-byte before GBA-5a patches it from source. Not the suite's real recipe (GBA-3/5a add rom_variant: veloce patches across the full 114-ROM jsmolka/alyosha collection); this one ROM exists to gate the toolchain, per docs/testing/testrom-plan.md GBA-2.
